# firebaseappdistribution_group_member (Resource)

Membership of a single tester in a Firebase App Distribution group. Creating the resource joins the tester to the group (`groups:batchJoin`) and destroying it removes the tester from the group (`groups:batchLeave`). The tester itself is never removed from the project, so destroying this resource does not revoke access to releases that were distributed to the tester directly.

Use one resource per tester, typically with `for_each` over a set of email addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  qa_testers = [
    "alice@example.com",
    "bob@example.com",
  ]
}

resource "firebaseappdistribution_group" "qa" {
  group_id     = "qa"
  display_name = "QA team"
}

resource "firebaseappdistribution_group_member" "qa" {
  for_each = toset(local.qa_testers)

  group_id = firebaseappdistribution_group.qa.group_id
  email    = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the tester. Compared case-insensitively against the API. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `group_id` (String) Alias of the group. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `create_missing_tester` (Boolean) Whether to register the email as a tester of the project when it is not one yet. When `false`, joining an unknown email fails. Defaults to `true`.
- `project` (String) Firebase project ID or number. Defaults to the provider `project`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic ID in the form `projects/{project_number}/groups/{group_id}/testers/{email}`, using the project number and the email as registered in the project.
- `tester_display_name` (String) Display name of the tester as registered in the project.
- `tester_name` (String) Resource name of the tester, in the form `projects/{project_number}/testers/{email}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import 'firebaseappdistribution_group_member.qa["alice@example.com"]' projects/my-firebase-project/groups/qa/testers/alice@example.com
```
